summary: Evaluate the top-level outer-pass convergence: compares molecular density before/after an outer pass, re-enters while relative change exceeds truncate.

identity.relation: Evaluate the top-level outer-pass convergence: compares molecular density before/after an outer pass, re-enters while relative change exceeds truncate.
identity.direction: previous and current outer-pass molecular density profiles plus truncate -> top-level reentry decision
identity.definition: Evaluate the top-level outer-pass convergence: compares molecular density before/after an outer pass, re-enters while relative change exceeds truncate.
identity.model: the top-level outer-pass ratio-of-max relation with truncate threshold and fail-closed domain tightenings
identity.geometry: one spatial axis for two aligned density profiles
identity.boundary: nonempty aligned finite nonnegative real 1-D density arrays, positive current maximum, finite positive real truncate, and representable finite seed_error
assumptions: The relation applies the ratio-of-max test with a strict greater-than comparison against truncate; this top-level threshold is separate from the inner 10*truncate relation. SciRel rejects non-real coercions and non-finite derived values.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the residual is recorded as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: previous_density_m3
inputs.description: The density profile before the pass.

inputs.name: current_density_m3
inputs.description: The density profile after the pass.
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonnegative, one-dimensional, same shape as previous.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A mapping with seed_error (relative change), reentry_threshold (truncate), should_reiterate (bool), and reason ('reiterate' or 'converged').
outputs.dtype: mapping of scalars and a boolean
outputs.constraints: Finite seed_error; reentry_threshold = truncate; should_reiterate is a Python bool.

preconditions: Nonempty finite nonnegative aligned density profiles, positive current maximum and positive truncate.
excluded: Non-density convergence criteria; external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for empty, non-real, non-finite, negative or misaligned density vectors, nonpositive current maximum, or non-real/non-finite/nonpositive truncate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if finite inputs overflow seed_error.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this relation reports convergence, it does not iterate.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_kn1d_outer_convergence
prev = np.array([100.0])
curr = np.array([100.05])
result = evaluate_kn1d_outer_convergence(prev, curr, truncate=0.1)
assert result['should_reiterate'] is False
assert result['reentry_threshold'] == 0.1
curr2 = np.array([120.0])
result2 = evaluate_kn1d_outer_convergence(prev, curr2, truncate=0.1)
assert result2['should_reiterate'] is True
example.expected: For current=[100.05], seed_error=0.0004997501249375028 and should_reiterate=False; for current=[120], seed_error=0.16666666666666666 and should_reiterate=True.
